lines: This tiny engine beats an 8B-parameter LLM. And it's 11× faster.
On one RTX 3070, it yields **68** decisions per second. The comparison uses the same model and tokens.
Short inputs on CPU: Statim is **257 ms** per state. ONNX Runtime takes **266 ms**. Parity holds.
Resident memory at start-up is **276 MiB**. ONNX Runtime needs nearly twice that. Trust the numbers.
On S1Bench with **3,880** items, it scores macro accuracy of **0.638**. It beats the untuned base.
With only **307M** parameters, it wins nine of fourteen decision categories. Qwen3-8B gets five.
Runtime is just **5.5 MB** plus a GGUF file. Laya needs Python stacks and heavy libraries.
Cold start to first answer takes only **0.76 s**. ONNX Runtime waits over two seconds.
Download the **3 MB** engine and model in one curl command. Verify with SHA checksums.
Call `POST  v1 systemone` to decide for one state. The API returns answers instantly.
Source code is Apache-2.0, free for any use. No hidden licenses or keys required.
Send this to someone who needs fast AI decisions today.
